title: Sharpness of Minima in Deep Matrix Factorization

official.claim: For a depth-3 Gaussian factorization of a 10×20 matrix, with GD started 1e-12 from the minimizer along the top Hessian eigenvector, GD with η = 2/λmax (λmax from Theorem 3.1) stays at the minimizer for 2000 iterations. With η = 1.01×2/λmax and 1.02×2/λmax, GD escapes after about 1250 and 650 iterations: the loss spikes to about 3e-4 and 1.3e-3 of ||M||_F^2, and the iterates settle at normalized squared distances of about 0.5e-5 and 2.05e-5 from w*.
official.metric: Normalized squared distance ||w_t − w*||_2^2/||w*||_2^2 after T = 2000 iterations, plus the normalized training loss L(w_t)/||M||_F^2. Escape means the final distance is far above the initial ~1e-24 scale. One random instance; no ± is reported.
official.comparison: GD at step sizes just below/at 2/λmax vs. just above 2/λmax, where λmax is the paper's closed form (Theorem 3.1). The implicit check is that the closed form equals the true top Hessian eigenvalue, so the stability threshold lands exactly at η = 2/λmax.
official.falsification_criterion: Refuted if the closed-form λmax differs from the top eigenvalue of the numerically computed Hessian at w* (beyond floating-point error) for random minimizers, or if GD at η = 2/λmax × 1.01 (started along v_1 at r = 1e-12) does not leave w* while η ≤ 2/λmax does, i.e., the observed stability threshold is not at 2/λmax.

title: ITPEval: Benchmarking Formal Translation Across Interactive Theorem Provers

official.claim: On zero-shot proof translation (pass@1, verified by the target prover), GPT-5.5 translates 57/192 (29.7%) of the controlled Tier A (Babel-formal) directed pairs but only 36/696 (5.2%) of the ecosystem Tier B (Formalizing 100 Theorems) pairs. All five models score lower on Tier B (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro: 18.2% vs 1.4%).
official.metric: Proof-translation pass@1 (%): the fraction of directed source-target file pairs whose single greedy output compiles in the target prover with no placeholders. Higher is better. Per-tier numbers have no error bars. Appendix Table 9 gives 95% Wilson CIs only for the overall rates (GPT-5.5 overall 10.5% [8.6, 12.7]).
official.comparison: The same model and protocol on Tier A (Babel-formal, 192 directed pairs) vs Tier B (Formalizing 100 Theorems, 696 directed pairs), for each of five LLMs.
official.falsification_criterion: Running GPT-5.5 (or the strongest available model) under the same protocol gives Tier A and Tier B proof pass@1 rates within a few percentage points of each other, or Tier B at or above Tier A. A Tier A rate far below 29.7% for GPT-5.5 would also cast doubt on the reported numbers.
